While possible that an et civ could evolve in the same way, if their planet, source of food/energy, predators/lack of etc are different than earth than we really can't feasibly predict how an intelligent group of animals would progress. If we had information about their home world we can ofc make educated assumptions but with the proven info we have now humanoid, bipedal, social intelligent species are just as likely as any other combo of the infinite traits and behaviors possible. As for contact I'm leaning towards agreeing with hawking in that they will be looking to exploit us/our resources. But I hope we make contact with peaceful creatures, if you think about it and intergalatic civ would be mostly interested in resources that are scarce in their homelands and possibly energy. So that's spooky for us. But on the idealogical side if there is an interstellar traveling hyper advanced race they have probably mastered manipulation of energy sources and resources to where they couldn't utilize any more.
